grammar.summary: 本课学习 without 引导的动名词结构与定语从句表考古叙事。

points.title: without + 动名词表条件缺省
points.explanation: They could not write without... = 没有……就无法。without + V-ing 表"在没有……的情况下"，逻辑上等于虚拟条件。

examples.en: Anthropologists wondered where the remote ancestors of the Polynesian peoples now living in the Pacific Islands came from.
examples.cn: 人类学家想知道如今生活在太平洋群岛上的波利尼西亚人的远古祖先来自哪里。

points.title: 定语从句表限制性说明
points.explanation: now living in the Pacific 是现在分词作后置定语（= who now live）；legends handed down by storytellers 过去分词作后置定语（被动），分词定语是第四册高频结构。

examples.cn: 由说书人世代相传的传说。

points.title: that 表连读的宾语从句链
points.explanation: The only way that they can preserve their history is to recount it... 主语从句嵌套不定式表语，长句骨架分析示范。

examples.en: The only way that they can preserve their history is to recount it as sagas.
examples.cn: 他们保存历史的唯一办法是把它作为英雄传说讲述出来。
